title: Bayesian Hiring Agent
outcome: A multi-model approach to resume screening that uses additional evaluation for uncertain cases.
context: Described in my sole-authored preprint, "Bayesian Orchestration of Multi-LLM Agents for Cost-Aware Sequential Decision-Making" (arXiv 2601.01522).
problem: Using an expensive model for every application increases the cost of screening. Using a cheaper model for every application can miss cases that need closer review.
approach: Use several LLMs in sequence. When an earlier assessment is uncertain, send the application to a more capable model for another pass.
